baseline_prompt_en: Create a photographic autumn fashion editorial of a fictional adult woman wearing layered autumn clothing, with her face and hair guided by the supplied reference. Preserve its oval facial outline, dark gray-brown eyes, softly shaped nose and full muted rose lips; her short black bob curves inward around the jaw beneath separated wispy bangs. She is an invented observatory assistant caught halfway through carrying a loose sky chart indoors after a shower. On the flagstone terrace of a small hilltop observatory, an open instrument-room doorway glows behind her; a telescope barrel is softly visible inside. A waist-high stone ledge beside her is dark with water beads, so the loose paper must stay above it. A gust has curled the chart's exposed upper corner toward that wet ledge. Her left forearm supports the bottom of a stiff dark-blue document portfolio at her left hip, and her left fingers curl around its lower outer edge. The portfolio is held upright with its front cover slightly open toward the camera: the chart's lower half rests flat inside, while its upper half protrudes above the cover with a few dark star dots joined by fine lines. Her right elbow bends comfortably across her lower chest; her right thumb and index finger pinch the free upper corner and lift its curled tip clear of the ledge. The lower half is already sheltered inside the portfolio, while the lifted corner stays visibly dry above the beaded stone. Both hands and their separate contacts are visible. She looks directly at the lifted paper corner, brows gently drawn in concentration and lips softly parted as the immediate problem begins to ease. A slight lift of her bob and coat edge carries the same breeze through the frame. Her navy wool double-breasted peacoat is worn open, with broad notched lapels, two aligned rows of large dark buttons and separate short fronts ending at the hips. A soft brushed nap remains visible on the wool. A cream cable-knit mock-neck sweater sits inside the coat; raised cable columns show through the open front, and narrow cream knitted cuffs extend beyond the navy coat sleeves. Below the coat, a russet A-line midi skirt shows distinct narrow vertical corduroy wales and a relaxed fold responding to her turn. Chestnut leather lace-up ankle boots have neatly tied laces, gentle ankle flex creases and solid soles on the damp flagstones. Both boot soles rest on the level terrace, her weight settled over her left leg and her right toe turned toward the doorway. The portfolio stays beside her left hip, leaving the coat opening and most of the skirt readable. Use a vertical full-body frame with a small margin above her hair and both complete boots visible, from a slight front three-quarter position near chest height. Keep the lifted paper, her face and the garment layers clear at the same time, with the doorway and ledge still recognizable behind and beside her. Soft cool late-afternoon daylight reveals the wool nap, knit loops and corduroy ribs; a restrained warm glow from the doorway touches one side of her face. A few copper leaves adhere to the damp stone near the threshold. The scene feels attentively observed and quietly appealing, with the delicate paper rescue as the living moment inside a tactile, believable autumn outfit.
